Doctrine and Covenants 1:17, 22; emphasis added. A vital part of the restoration of the everlasting covenant was the return of priesthood keys to the Prophet Joseph Smith through heavenly messengers. These include the keys of the gathering of Israel, the dispensation of the gospel of Abraham, and the sealing power (seeDoctrine and Covenants 110:11–16). President Nelson taught that these keys authorize the Presidents of the Church “to gather Israel on both sides of the veil, to bless all covenant children with the blessings of Abraham, to place a ratifying seal on priesthood ordinances and covenants, and to seal families eternally” (“Rejoice in the Gift of Priesthood Keys,”Liahona, May 2024, 121).

The Old Testament lays the foundation of the covenant theme that continues throughout the standard works. Later scripture writers frequently wrote with the expectation that their readers would be familiar with this foundation (seeDeuteronomy 30:10–14;Joshua 1:8;Luke 24:44–45;Acts 3:19–26;2 Timothy 3:16–17;1 Nephi 19:23–24;Doctrine and Covenants 52:9;66:2).
